How do you debug flaky translation requests?

Original post

I am seeing intermittent request failures in a browser extension and want advice on whether to retry in content scripts or keep the retry logic in the background worker.

My current setup uses several short posts in a thread rather than one coherent article, so this page should not be treated as a single longform reading surface.

Reply one

Keep retries centralised and typed so popup state and inline actions can surface the same failure semantics.

Reply two

Add more test fixtures before changing readability heuristics, otherwise every future tweak becomes guesswork.
